economy.summary: Her official House biography says her main objective is to restore security and prosperity to Pennsylvania's economy by supporting private-sector job creation and a pro-business environment, and that she supports policies to preserve and support family farms.
economy.short: Supports private-sector job creation, pro-business policies, family farms.

taxes.summary: Has said property tax reform would remain a priority if she were reelected and has expressed opposition to tax increases in the upcoming state budget.
taxes.short: Prioritizes property tax reform; opposes state budget tax increases.

abortion.summary: Voted in July 2022 for Senate Bill 106, a proposed state constitutional amendment providing that there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion or other right relating to abortion in Pennsylvania.
abortion.short: Voted for amendment declaring no constitutional right to abortion.

guns.summary: Her official House biography states that she brings support of Second Amendment rights to her representation of the district.
guns.short: Official biography states support of Second Amendment rights.

economy.summary: His campaign platform proposes increasing Pennsylvania's minimum wage for the first time since 2009, saying all working Pennsylvanians deserve a livable wage.
economy.short: Proposes raising minimum wage; says workers deserve livable wage.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform proposes supporting small and family-owned businesses by lowering their tax rates, with tax incentives tied to local hiring, wage growth, and capital investment.
taxes.short: Proposes lowering small-business taxes with hiring-linked incentives.

guns.summary: His campaign platform proposes strengthening police, fire, and emergency services through increased funding and best practices in training, transparency, and community outreach; his site does not detail a position on gun policy.
guns.short: Proposes funding, training, transparency for police and emergency services.
